name: hourloom
description: Hourloom — one NestJS API, three portals, a public site and its docs, and the shared packages they are built from.

scripts.test: bun run --filter @lms/shared test && bun run --filter @lms/ui test && bun run --filter @lms/api test && bun run --filter @lms/student test && bun run --filter @lms/teacher test && bun run --filter @lms/ops test && bun run --filter @lms/site test
scripts.verify: bun run build:shared && bun run docker:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker build api && docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker build site && docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker build teacher && docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker build student && docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker build ops && docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker build gateway
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose --env-file docker/.env.docker --profile tools run --rm seed
